metadata.name: BMC Illuminati Pass #1 - Legendary Genesis
metadata.description: The one. The first BMC Illuminati Pass ever minted: the Legendary Genesis, the rarest piece of the 500-piece collection. A mysterious hooded frog with a glowing golden third eye, crowned and veiled, beneath the floating golden eye-in-triangle. Minted by permanently burning 1,000,000 BMC.
